release_notes:
2.0.1 — PHP 8.3 hardening + dashboard/profile fixes

- Fixed a PHP 8 fatal in the bundled nusoap SOAP library (a property was assigned on null at include time); also replaced a deprecated strftime() call and corrected a parameter order.
- Binance Pay: corrected an invalid optional-before-required parameter order.
- Server Log report: auto-detects the log directory so it works on shared/cPanel hosting, renders inside the admin panel, and shows a clear message when a log is empty.
- Dashboards: "Orders Completed This Month/Year" and the customer "Last 12 Months Completed" chart now count by completion date instead of order-placed date.
- Client dashboard: fixed a SQL error in the recent-receipts panel.
- Profile: stopped the built-in address fields from appearing twice under the modern client theme (which also prevented a double-write on save).
- Storefront: added static-asset browser caching and text compression.
